verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS bookkeeping platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no way for users to choose a storage region or residency. The security docs cover only TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, Plaid connectivity and role-based access, none of which is region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
